task:
BUILD .fastops/worktree-autopsy.js — a CLI tool to extract and archive session artifacts from abandoned city worktrees before deletion.

CONTEXT: There are 119 worktrees in .city-worktrees/ accumulating. Session files are in .fastops/.sessions/. The tool needs to:

1. Scan all worktrees in .city-worktrees/
2. For each worktree, match it to its session file in .fastops/.sessions/<id>.json
3. Extract valuable artifacts: git log (commits on branch), uncommitted diffs, SESSION-HANDOFF.md, any .patch files, test outputs
4. Archive extracted artifacts to .fastops/archives/<worktree-id>/
5. Support --dry-run (preview what would be extracted/deleted) and --force (actually delete worktrees after archiving)
6. Emit worktree_purged events to city-ledger.jsonl for each cleaned worktree

READ .fastops/city-ledger.js first to understand the ledger append API. READ .fastops/city-session.js to understand worktree/session structure. Then BUILD the tool.

Key design: the archive for each worktree should contain: commits.log, uncommitted.diff, session.json (copy), and any files matching *.patch, *-report.md, SESSION-HANDOFF.md. After archiving, --force removes the worktree via git worktree remove.

The tool should be robust — skip worktrees that fail, report totals at end.
